About Senate Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry

About Senate Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry

The jurisdiction of the Senate Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry is specified in Rule XXV, Clause 1 of the Senate Manual. Visit the committee's website for more information including membership and rules.

See the latest committee rules as printed in the Congressional Record.

The publications on this page are available at the committee's discretion. A "No results found" message below means there are currently no applicable publications in the system.
